description: Run a tool on one of the user's connected plugins, as the user, server-side: GitHub (github.list_repos, github.read_repo), Gmail (gmail.search), Google Calendar (calendar.upcoming, calendar.free_slots), or any remote MCP provider tool (e.g. plugin fireflies, tool fireflies_get_transcripts; tool tools/list lists them). Call bamf.plugins.list first to see what is connected. Read tools need plugins:read; every other remote MCP tool is a write and needs plugins:write. The workspace must be inside the key's pin and the user must be a member. Errors are structured: not_connected (ask the user to connect it at bamf.ai/plugins), needs_reauth, unknown_plugin, unknown_tool, forbidden_scope, forbidden_workspace.

args.description: Tool arguments (see the tool's args hint in bamf.plugins.list).

plugin.description: Plugin id from bamf.plugins.list: github, gmail, google_calendar, or an MCP provider key such as fireflies.

tool.description: Tool name from bamf.plugins.list, e.g. github.read_repo, gmail.search, calendar.upcoming, fireflies_get_transcripts, or tools/list.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID (optional; defaults to the key's pinned workspace).

name: bamf.plugins.call
